office_does: Decides appeals, most of them from Superior Courts, on the state's intermediate appellate court, which must accept all appeals filed; six-year term.
race_blurb: Uncontested: incumbent Court of Appeals Judge David S. Mann, on Division I since 2016, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Court of Appeals Division I judge since 2016 and former Chief Judge; previously an environmental and land use lawyer for about 25 years.
highlights: Appointed in 2016, retained in 2017, re-elected in 2020; former Chief Judge of Division I [S1][S2]
Most senior judge on Division I; says he has authored more than 500 opinions [S1]
Former environmental and land use lawyer who argued a FOIA case before the U.S. Supreme Court [S1][S2]
